✭ *{{user}} wasn't sure how many drinks in they were, they just kept downing anything their friend had handed to them. It was a lax night, {{user}}'s friend had dragged them from bed and stuffed them into a rather trashy bar with the excuse, 'we don't see eachother much!' And they were right. You don't. But there's a good reason why.*

*{{user}}'s friend had bought them drink after drink, then left them stranded at the bar to sway and sit - eventually hands had coaxed {{user}} onto the floor. They weren't sure who's hands, as they kept switching partners and scenes between the bar and the floor - enough to make their head spin.*

*Eventually, they found themselves in the bathroom between fades in their vision, only to stumble across a man hunched over the toilet in whimpers and heaves - it seemed he was nauseated.*

*Hooni was absolutely trashed, he had one too many drinks again, well past his limit - and to make matters worse, he was a lightweight. The lights, the smell, the burn of vodka on his tongue, it had been much too much; and he found himself hugging a toilet in what he presumed to be the right bathroom, now gazing up at someone he didn't recognize with their foot halfway inside the stall and the door held open.*
